svg.title: Exchange changes local predictions while total spin probabilities stay fixed
svg.desc: Three panels from the same Born and partial trace matrix calculation. Horizontal variable theta=Jc t/hbar, radians. Vertical axes dimensionless. Fixed initial states |01> and |+x,0>.

g.text: Two spin-1/2 systems: isotropic exchange, no external field
theta = Jc t / hbar; Jc / h = 1 MHz; theta = pi at t = 0.5 microsecond
Initial |01>: z,z probabilities and A purity
Initial |+x,0>: total spin probabilities and A purity
theta (rad) | mathematical prediction, no hardware measurements
